title: PLAYER 2 SEES SEARCH CONES ON BUILT BODIES
why: Searchers draw a widening amber scan cone and DESIGN says player 2 sees the same cones. But the bodies that exist from the raid build are player 2 own copies with no net flag, so searching() took the host branch, which needs a search point that only the host AI sets; player 2 window runs no AI, so it never drew a cone on any of those bodies even though the host row carried the search flag. Proven in headless Chromium: a staged player 2 window applies a real host row with the search bit, the flag lands (srch 1) but searching() is false and searchCone() is null. Now, in a linked player 2 window up top, every body takes searching from the host flag, and draws the middle ring, as the bodies the host sends later already did. Solo and host windows are unchanged.
now: In co-op, player 2 now sees the amber search cone on every searching enemy, the same as player 1.
